```yaml
name: Community PR Permissions Check

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  check-permissions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed-files
        uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v46
        with:
          separator: "\n"

      - name: Verify changed files are allowed
        run: |
          echo "Changed files:"
          echo "${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.all_changed_and_modified_files }}"

          # Define paths that community PRs are allowed to modify
          ALLOWED_PATHS=(
            "airbyte-integrations/connectors/"
            "docs/"
            "scripts/"
          )

          FAIL=0

          # Iterate over each changed file
          printf "%s\n" "${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.all_changed_and_modified_files }}" | while IFS= read -r file; do
            # Skip empty lines
            [[ -z "$file" ]] && continue

            allowed=0
            for prefix in "${ALLOWED_PATHS[@]}"; do
              if [[ "$file" == $prefix* ]]; then
                allowed=1
                break
              fi
            done

            if [[ $allowed -eq 0 ]]; then
              echo "❌ File '$file' is not allowed in community PRs."
              FAIL=1
            fi
          done

          if [[ $FAIL -ne 0 ]]; then
            echo "❌ Community PR contains disallowed changes."
            exit 1
          else
            echo "✅ All changes are allowed."
          fi
        shell: bash
```
